newsitem.title: USA: Network Peripherals sees Q1 shr loss.
newsitem.headline: Network Peripherals sees Q1 shr loss.

text.p: Network Peripherals Inc said on Monday it expected to report a net loss for the quarter ending March 31 of up to $0.08 per share, due to weaker than expected sales of its FDDI products.
The company said it expected net sales for the quarter to be in a range of $11.5 million to $12.5 million, below the previous quarter and lower than analysts' expectations.

"There is no doubt that we are experiencing some market confusion resulting in a slowdown similar to what is happening in the rest of the networking industry," Pauline Lo Alker, president and chief executive officer, said.
